skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 2 consecutive strikes, dealing DMG by 500% ATK. Every strike has a 50% chance to add 1 stack of [Specialized Burn] (DoT by 300% ATK; after any character acts, transfers the effect to a random target, disappears after transferring 3 times) to the target.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Ultimate ATK: 500% → 700%.[Specialized Burn] stack chance: 50% → 80%.[Specialized Burn] DoT: 300% → 400%.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, grants 60% Non-Crit DMG Free (reduces all types of Non-Crit DMG, cannot co-exist with [Agility]).After any character acts, [Detonate] the [Specialized Burn] (400% of a single [Specialized Burn]'s DMG turns into [Detonation] DMG).

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: After any character acts, absorbs 40% [Detonation] DMG and deals [True DMG] ( Not affected by DMG Rate and DMG Free, deal direct DMG without [DMG Sharing] or [Evasion]) to 3 characters with the lowest HP

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Deals True Damage to 3 characters with the lowest HP > entire enemy team

effects.desc: Effect disperses damage taken to allies; [True DMG] bypasses it by hitting Blood directly.
Activate a stack of damage over time or stored [Collapse] to instantly explode, turning it into an instant multiplier (e.g. 3 times the stored damage).
Evasion type buff; mutually exclusive with Non-Crit Damage Immunity.
The dodge status reduces Direct, Bonus, Charged, and Fury damage taken to just 1 point for the duration.
This type of bonus damage is dealt on top of attacks, is reduced by Evasion-type effects, and can be immune after a certain number of turns.
Burning PvP tier — stronger burst damage, harder to deal with.
